scope: Two sequential diagnostic captures per actual project on the unchanged deployed executable and immutable assets. No concurrent builds/tests/inference or second sampler. Existing OS/project/semantic caches are retained. No product changes or speedup claim.

captures.methodology: Real GUI pointer/wheel/click events with document-thread CDP dispatch spans and sampled CPU profiles. Each window records its original process/thread; ambiguous or missing marks fail instead of producing empty measurements. Worker callbacks are excluded from UI-thread stages. Input-to-two-rAF is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or INP. Nested trace spans overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Profiling and automation add overhead; one controlled desktop run is not a field percentile.

sample_clock.weighting: Cumulative sample timestamps sorted stably, nonnegative preceding intervals clipped to original profile/event bounds. Approximate point-sample attribution; excludes unsampled trailing time.

limits: Inclusive synchronous handlers exclude later asynchronous rendering. Nested trace/native spans overlap and must not be added as exclusive cost.
Sampled browser self time includes native operations, GC, idle/program and automation. The point-sample interval filter is approximate, not instruction tracing.
Two animation callbacks are a presentation proxy, not physical paint or field INP.
Native thread CPU excludes child processes. Sampling percentages do not decompose wall time.
Deep drill contains category animations, lazy details and automation; total action elapsed includes settling and is not handler latency.
Two drill wheel events and one Fit View click per capture are observations, not population percentiles. Missing queue entries are unavailable, not zero.
Captured interactions preserve tested hover/tab/selection cameras; arbitrary simultaneous pointer/zoom resets are not ruled out.
Compilation/search/rendering are retained cache hits; initial compilation, cold install and model-turn performance are outside this audit.
